business_problem: Turbo AI needed to collapse a costly multi-cloud setup into a single AI infrastructure platform that could support PB-scale data migration, elastic GPU capacity, low-latency networking, and strong end-to-end security for AI and autonomous-driving workloads.
solution_summary: Turbo AI assembled an integrated Alibaba Cloud architecture for AI infrastructure delivery across migration, networking, compute, and security. Cloud Enterprise Network provides the compliant, high-performance backbone for cross-environment traffic, while Lightning Cube and Online Migration Service move PB-scale data from IDC environments into the cloud. GPU services deliver instant, elastic capacity for video-recognition and other AI workloads, and Alibaba Cloud Model Studio underpins the AI Model Studio IDE that supports end-to-end model development and deployment. On the delivery side, CDN improves video-resource load times for end users. Security is built in across layers with Anti-DDoS, Web Application Firewall, Cloud Firewall, and Security Center, creating protection that spans traffic, host, application, and data layers. This gives Turbo AI a single platform that is easier to operate, less fragmented than its previous multi-cloud estate, and better matched to regional clients that need AI infrastructure from lightweight model execution through large-scale cluster management.
business_outcome: Turbo AI improved resource efficiency, accelerated video-resource delivery, and strengthened multi-layer security while giving clients a more integrated AI infrastructure service.
architecture_clues: The platform is designed for AI and autonomous-driving use cases
Model Studio is paired with an AI lifecycle development environment
Security coverage spans traffic, host, application, and data layers
CDN acceleration is specifically used to speed video-resource delivery
evidence_quotes: "Lightning Cube addresses challenges such as large-scale data transfer efficiency and security, enabling the need for secure and efficient PB-level data migration from IDC to the cloud."
"GPU service offers instant availability and elastic scaling capabilities, catering to customers' demands for cost-efficient and high-performance processing for video content recognition."
"Turbo AI has built a comprehensive multi-layered protection system using Alibaba Cloud’s Anti-DDoS, Web Application Firewall (WAF), Cloud Firewall, Security Center, SSL, and Content Security."
